title: Common guided pin captured by two spiral slots
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of B (spin) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. One positive angular increment changes the sampled radii by 2 and -2 mm. Both grooves must reach the same translating pin displacement. A positive, B negative. The requested motion is CCW (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: B must be CCW. One positive angular increment changes the sampled radii by 2 and -2 mm. Both grooves must reach the same translating pin displacement. A positive, B negative..

options.label: B
options.explanation: B must be CCW. One positive angular increment changes the sampled radii by 2 and -2 mm. Both grooves must reach the same translating pin displacement. A positive, B negative..

options.label: C
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.
